title: Avocado Flatbread Bruschetta
description: A simple and flavorful appetizer or snack featuring toasted flatbread topped with fresh avocado, lightly blanched vegetables, and a hint of herbs.
instructions: 2. Slice the flatbread into 1-inch thick rounds.
3. Place the flatbread slices on a baking sheet and toast in the oven for 5-7 minutes, or until lightly browned.
4. Meanwhile, mash the avocado in a bowl and set aside.
5. Once the flatbread is toasted, let it cool for a minute or two before topping with mashed avocado.
6. Add the lightly blanched tomato, sliced cucumber, and thinly sliced red onion on top of the avocado.
7. Sprinkle chopped fresh parsley over the top and season with salt to taste.
8. Drizzle balsamic vinegar over the flatbread and serve immediately.
